text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I caught sight of Tokai Teio secretly peeking in on Mejiro McQueen as she trained...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah, great timing!
Hey, hey, can I ask you for a favor?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'm supposed to find the reason McQueen was chosen for the URA poster, but... I haven't been able to find it yet...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: And it looks like she already found the reason I was chosen...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: So, please! Could you casually probe around and see what kind of answer McQueen came up with?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, having been semi-forcibly dispatched, I made my way over to Mejiro McQueen...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh, you are... Forgive me for that unsightly display the other day desu wa...
choice_data_list: There was something I wanted to ask...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Something you wished to ask... Truth be told, as a Trainer, I have something I would like to consult you on as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I have been given an assignment, but I simply cannot seem to find the answer...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seemed Mejiro McQueen was struggling with the assignment just as much as Tokai Teio. In that case—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: W-Wait, what are you doing!? Don't come over this wayーー!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Since both were troubled by the exact same problem, I decided to take the plunge and have the two of them talk it out directly.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Whaaaaat!? So you hadn't figured out anything either, McQueen~?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: If you didn't have an answer, why were you acting so totally relaxed about it~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: You were acting as if you had found yours first and teased me about it, were you not!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Look who's talking, acting all tough and then coming to Trainer for help!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: If it comes to that, were you not the one who relied on them first, Teio-san?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Because, well... That's because...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I just really didn't want to lose! Because, McQueen...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You have so many strengths that I don't have... You're always so patient, and you never give up no matter the obstacle...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Thinking that your perseverance would definitely help you find the answer made me panic...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...That goes for me as well. Knowing you, Teio-san, I assumed you would arrive at the answer through some brilliant idea I could never even fathom...
choice_data_list: Isn't that the answer to the assignment?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The assignment's... Ah.
Strengths that neither of us possess on our own...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I get it now...
That's the reason we were chosen...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Possessing the strengths the other lacks... is it?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Individually, there are shortcomings, but together, you can achieve perfection... Is that what you mean?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Not quite. When I look at McQueen, I can see what I'm lacking.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: So I try to become stronger to fill in those gaps... because I don't want to lose to her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: We are not perfect. However, as long as we compete and refuse to be discouraged, we can continue to grow stronger...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: It is precisely because of that relationship that you chose us, is it not?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Splendid! I wished to see what you two would discover in one another, but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: This answer surpasses my expectations. Competing with and encouraging each other, inspiring many while forging a new path ahead...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I look forward to seeing the brilliance of your friendly rivalry serve as a beacon lighting the way to the future!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, we got praised~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Please do not get too carried away.
Nothing good comes of letting it go to your head...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh? What is that—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Did you see the poster?!
The one with Teio-san and McQueen-san!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
They both looked so pretty!
So elegant and cool~.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I want the two of us to be on
a poster like that someday too!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yeah! We definitely will! It's a promise!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I see, so that is what the torch represents...
We shall simply have to grow even stronger, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You bet! Let's get way, waaay more awesome!
And shine so brightly that nobody can miss us!
